# Plugins

A plugin is something the gateway does to a request or a response. Each instance is attached to a route, a service, a workspace or every request; when several of one type could apply, the most specific wins. See [plugin scopes and order](../../concepts/plugins.md).

In the order they run by default:

| Plugin | What it does | Priority |
|---|---|---|
| [ip_restriction](ip_restriction.md) | Allows or denies requests by client address. deny wins. | 3000 |
| [cors](cors.md) | Cross-origin resource sharing. Preflight requests are answered by the gateway. | 2900 |
| [request_size_limit](request_size_limit.md) | Refuses request bodies over a size. | 2800 |
| [mtls_auth](mtls_auth.md) | Authenticates a consumer by client certificate. Revocation is not checked. | 2500 |
| [jwt_auth](jwt_auth.md) | Verifies a JSON Web Token and optionally maps it to a consumer. | 2400 |
| [key_auth](key_auth.md) | Authenticates a consumer by an API key. | 2300 |
| [basic_auth](basic_auth.md) | Authenticates a consumer by user name and password. | 2200 |
| [forward_auth](forward_auth.md) | Asks another service whether a request may pass. A 2xx answer allows it; any other answer is given to the client. | 2100 |
| [acl](acl.md) | Allows or denies authenticated consumers by group. deny wins. | 2000 |
| [rate_limit](rate_limit.md) | Token-bucket request rate limit. | 1900 |
| [quota](quota.md) | A request allowance per calendar hour, day or month, UTC. Counted per node. | 1800 |
| [bandwidth_limit](bandwidth_limit.md) | Byte-budget token bucket: admission before proxying, debit after the response. | 1700 |
| [concurrency_limit](concurrency_limit.md) | A cap on requests in progress at once: a request takes a slot when it starts and gives it back when it ends. | 1650 |
| [http_callout](http_callout.md) | Custom logic in any language: the node describes the request to a service (callout-request.json) and acts on its answer (callout-response.json). | 1500 |
| [redirect](redirect.md) | Answers with a redirect. Parts left out are taken from the request. | 1300 |
| [static_response](static_response.md) | Answers without an upstream: maintenance pages and mocks. | 1200 |
| [request_transformer](request_transformer.md) | Changes headers, query parameters and JSON body fields of the forwarded request. Operations run in the order rename, remove, set, add. Values are templates. | 1100 |
| [response_cache](response_cache.md) | Caches responses in memory, per node. Adds X-Apg-Cache: HIT, MISS or BYPASS. | 1000 |
| [response_transformer](response_transformer.md) | Changes headers and JSON body fields of the upstream's response. Operations run in the order rename, remove, set, add. Values are templates. | 900 |
| [compression](compression.md) | Compresses responses when the client accepts it. Responses that are already encoded are left alone. | 800 |
| [access_log](access_log.md) | Changes access logging for the requests in its scope. The access log never includes header values, so there is nothing to redact. | 100 |

Not available yet: `wasm`.
